sql: WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) , career AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN results re USING(driver_id)), latest AS (SELECT ts.* FROM team_seasons ts WHERE ts.constructor_id=(SELECT re.constructor_id FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE r.year=ts.year AND re.driver_id=ts.driver_id ORDER BY r.round DESC LIMIT 1)), scoring AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN results re USING(driver_id) JOIN races r ON r.race_id=re.race_id AND r.year=l.year WHERE re.points>0), variants AS (SELECT 'career' method,year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM career UNION ALL SELECT 'latest_team',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT 'scoring_team',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM scoring UNION ALL SELECT 'same_year_driver_count',year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year,driver_id,constructor_id FROM team_seasons)), sums AS (SELECT method,constructor_id,CASE WHEN method='same_year_driver_count' THEN COUNT(*) ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT year) END n FROM variants GROUP BY method,constructor_id), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY method ORDER BY n DESC,constructor_id) rn FROM sums) SELECT method,c.name,n,rn FROM ranked JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE rn<=8 ORDER BY method,rn
